config.description: M1 v1.1: region-limited residual energy (F1) + main-bin phase std (F2) + breathing band ratio (F3) + reserved motion slot (F4), gated score, dual-threshold hysteresis with confirm debounce and static gate. Demo-compatible structure with re-tuned weights 0.45/0.30/0.25 so a static bag cannot cross T_ON alone (G1 condition b). hysteresis_confirm_frames=5 (feature-window frames + 1) rides out the bag-placement transient; static_gate.f23_floor forces release when the 4 s windowed mean of (F2n+F3n) < 0.10 (leave-with-bag protection, complex input only).
config.target_count_policy: 1 when presence=1 (single-seat region assumption, documented), 0 when empty, -1 when unknown

region_params.note: Nominal installation values from project plan 5.2 (24-24.25 GHz sweep -> 0.6 m resolution). Replace with measured values after real installation. Coarse-granularity risk documented: plan A region spans only ~3-4 bins.
region_params.bin_conversion: bin_lo = floor(region_m[0] / range_resolution_m); bin_hi = ceil(region_m[1] / range_resolution_m); clip to [0, n_range_bins-1]
